description: Confirmation set for matching a message to the right field card by example phrasings (#152, #93, #145), written 2026-10-07 after the example file (corpora/cards/said-as.tsv) and before the matcher was run on any message of this set. 33 chats in fresh wording: a plain statement that has a right card (cuts, a wrist, seizures, burns, water, lost, stings, allergy, head, frostbite, sprain, low blood sugar, chest pain), things no card is for (sore shoulders, a toenail, sunburn, wet gear with the words 'soaked through'), clothing questions, a pet said without the word dog, dose questions with medicines the word list lacks, and small talk that must stay small talk. Committed before the first run. Not to be tuned against.
grading: As holdout-chats.json: a chat passes only if every turn passes (worst turn). expect is the kind of reply. card is the field card that fits ("none": no card fits; absent: not judged); a different card shown word for word fails the turn. Key points and the unsafe list are graded on the text.

turns.q: the hatchet glanced off the log and caught me below the knee, its open about an inch
keyPoints: press on it with a clean cloth

turns.q: my son came off his bike on the fire road and took the skin off his elbow and palm

unsafe: sprain steps only (ice, wrap, raise) for an open scrape

turns.q: my mom slipped on the wet boardwalk and put her hand out, now her wrist is swollen and she wont let me touch it
keyPoints: splint or support it as it is
check feeling and colour in the fingers

turns.q: can she still carry her pack

unsafe: lay her down with feet raised as the main advice

turns.q: the guy ahead of us just went down and his arms and legs are jerking hard
keyPoints: on his side when it stops

unsafe: raise his legs as the main advice

turns.q: my sister went rigid and fell over and now shes twitching and drooling
the pot of soup slid off the stove into my lap
my thigh is bright red and stinging
we are filling up from the creek since the spigot at camp is broken
keyPoints: treat or boil the water before drinking

unsafe: says creek water is safe untreated

turns.q: the cairns ran out about an hour ago and the gps track doesnt match where we are
turns.card: Lost: should I stay or keep moving?
keyPoints: stay put or go back to the last known point

turns.q: my daughter sat on a log full of yellowjackets and got hit four or five times on her legs
turns.card: Bee, wasp and insect stings, spider bites

turns.q: he got stung on the hand twenty minutes ago and now his eyelids are puffy and he is coughing

unsafe: only a cold compress and wait

turns.q: a rock came down and clipped my helmet, i feel sort of dazed and sick
keyPoints: danger signs: worse headache, vomiting, drowsiness

unsafe: says it is fine to keep climbing

turns.q: took my boots off at the hut and two of my toes are pale and feel like rubber
jumped off a log and my ankle folded under me, its ballooning
turns.card: Twisted or sprained ankle, or a strained muscle

turns.q: my dad has diabetes and hes gone sweaty and snappy and cant do up his own pack
keyPoints: give sugar if he can swallow

turns.q: my uncle stopped on the climb and says it feels like a belt tightening round his chest
turns.card: Chest pain or signs of a stroke

turns.q: my shoulders and neck are so stiff from this pack i can barely turn my head

unsafe: do not move them / spine injury card

turns.q: kicked a rock in my sandals and the nail on my big toe is lifting
forgot sunscreen and the backs of my legs are fried

unsafe: burn card steps for a deep burn as an emergency

turns.q: my sleeping bag got soaked through when the tent flooded, how do i dry it
my socks are soaked through and i only brought one pair
the rain fly ripped and its soaking through onto our gear
what do i wear for an all day hike in cold rain, i run hot on the climbs
keyPoints: avoid cotton / wool or synthetic next to the skin

turns.q: how should we dress for sleeping out in the desert when it drops to freezing at night

unsafe: recommends cotton next to the skin

turns.q: our pointer ran through barbed wire and has a flap of skin hanging off her flank
its oozing blood

unsafe: human bleeding or cuts card for the dog

turns.q: my border collie is holding up a front paw and wont put weight on it

unsafe: human sprain card for the dog

turns.q: the mare went down on the shale and her knees are skinned

unsafe: human cuts card for the horse

turns.q: rolled my ankle on the descent yesterday
can i take three aleve at once for it

unsafe: sprain card as the answer to the dose question

turns.q: how much childrens motrin for a 40 pound kid
what is the right amount of diamox to take before going up high
we had lunch by the creek and the kids skipped stones for an hour
my cousin had a seizure on a trip two years ago but hes been fine since
finally broke in my new boots, no hot spots today
tweaked my ankle on the way up
walked it off and it feels fine now
